name: Moto Guzzi loop-frame (V7, Ambassador, Eldorado)
engine: 703 to 844 cc air-cooled transverse V-twin, two carbs, points, shaft drive
intro: The first Guzzi V-twins. Many were police bikes. Big, heavy and simple, with points and a generator.

H: Guzzi V-twins need the valves set and the throttle bodies or carbs balanced together. Do both at the same service.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
